issues.reason: A noun's argument PP attaches to the noun's OWN symbol ("a refinement of the earlier survey" -> `(Of sk_refinement_1 sk_survey_1)`), and the referent of "the American administrator for Iraq" is Bremer, so putting `For` on the kind asserts of American administrators at large what the text says of one man.
"An appositive has no tense of its own: its typing atom takes the host clause's wrapper — past host -> `(Past (Member halvard wheelwright))`", and the host clause "paid a ... visit" is past.

The singular "a brief, low-profile visit" fixes the event count at one, so the distributive default (one event per conjunct) is ruled out by the text itself, and two `Theme` atoms on one event are each true and well-typed — multi-filler role atoms are already within the vocabulary (the collective multi-`Agent` form) — which is acceptable improvisation in gap territory.

"Reserve the bare class symbol for a non-specific / generic object ... never for a specific definite individual" and an oblique's article-bearing object NP "mints a witness with its kind atom" — the instruction set's own "in the capital" example uses `sk_capital_1`, so "the north" must be a typed witness, not the bare untyped constant `north`.

gaps_confirmed: light / support-verb "paid a ... visit to X" — the light-verb collapse is scoped to occurred / happened / took place, so collapsing "paid" onto the visit witness (and giving the city `Theme` rather than the surface "to") is an extension
"Elsewhere" — a contrastive discourse-anaphoric locative adverb with no licensed encoding, dropped
new_gaps: a coordinated definite plural filling a single event's NON-Agent role ("a visit to the cities of Erbil and Suleimaniya"): the distributive default would mint one event per conjunct against the singular "a visit", and the collective multi-filler form is specified only for `Agent` on reciprocal/aggregate predicates
repair_summary: Moved the noun-argument oblique off the kind onto the referent: `(For american_administrator iraq)` -> `(For l_paul_bremer_iii iraq)` (individual fact, so 0.99 is now the right confidence). Wrapped the appositive typing atom in the host clause's past: `(Past (Member l_paul_bremer_iii american_administrator))`. Replaced the bare constant `north` with a typed witness — added `(Member sk_north_1 north)` and retargeted `(Location sk_visit_1 sk_north_1)`.
notes: The two `Theme` atoms are left untouched as licensed improvisation. The `For` atom is left unwrapped by `Past` because the appositive rule names Member / Inheritance / PartOf atoms, and no confirmed issue reaches its tense.
